ns2:course.label: Ethnicity in China
ns2:course.description: (ANTH 420) Explores ethnic diversity and ethnic relations in China. Topics include the multi-ethnic history of Chinese society, communist and Western theories on nationality and ethnicity, the state and ethnicity, ethnic conflict and political economy, gender and ethnic hierarchy. Same as EALC 487. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: ANTH 485 or consent of instructor.
